title: Reproducibility and provenance: hashing graphs and seeds

questions.q: Same graph hash, different pictures. What's a likely cause the hash can't see?
options: New weights under the same file name
questions.answer: New weights under the same file name
questions.why: The graph holds the name only. Seed, sampler and prompt are in the graph.

questions.q: Why sort keys before hashing a graph?
options: The same graph can otherwise give different text
questions.answer: The same graph can otherwise give different text
questions.why: Hash the same text for the same graph.

questions.q: Changing width by itself at one seed. What happens to the noise?
options: It changes, as the shape changes the draws
It stays in the same place
questions.answer: It changes, as the shape changes the draws
questions.why: The lab and the real function both show that.

questions.q: Two PNG files differ in hash, and the pictures look equal. What should you compare?
What does the PNG metadata not tell you?
options: The content of the weights file and the versions used
questions.answer: The content of the weights file and the versions used
questions.why: The graph is there. Files and versions aren't.
